name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-web-sandbox
description: Personal agent web-browsing sandbox for DeepSeek Harness: sanitizes fetched web content (hidden text, offsite images, inline base64) and scans third-party pages for prompt-injection attempts. A DSH desktop plugin.

summary.en: Sanitizes fetched web pages and scans them for prompt injection before the model sees them, with a canary echo-back watchdog.
summary.zh: 在内容进入模型之前净化抓取的网页并扫描提示注入，带金丝雀回声看门狗。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/sanitize.js && node --check lib/canary-watch.js
